---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or a meaningful change to an existing one
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What's the underlying user problem? Who runs into it, when, and what do they do today as a workaround?

## Proposed solution

How would you solve it? Sketch the UI / API change, not the implementation. If a small change in an existing surface covers it, say so.

## Alternatives considered

What else did you weigh, and why did you rule it out?

## Milestone fit

Which roadmap milestone fits, if any? The [GitHub Project](https://github.com/orgs/vidithq/projects/1) holds one `Epic:` issue per version and the open work by version, including the Unscheduled items. The [future considerations epic](https://github.com/vidithq/vidit/issues/535) lists deferred items with a documented rationale and revisit trigger: check that your proposal is not already covered there.

## Anything else

Mockups, examples from other tools, prior community discussion, all optional.
